rationale: S6 (#419): a `$:` reactive declaration is a component-state VARIABLE; the SAME target assigned from multiple `$:` blocks (here `doubled` from two blocks, `total` from one) is STILL a single variable. Each reactive target must be declared EXACTLY once — no per-block duplication. `doubled` and `total` are pinned to count exactly 1; `count` (exported prop) must remain a single Property.
